name: MomentsFeed
document: query MomentsFeed($first: Int, $after: String) { feed(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

name: MomentTranscodeStatus
document: query MomentTranscodeStatus($momentId: ID!) { momentTranscodeStatus(momentId: $momentId) { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } }

name: CreateMoment
document: mutation CreateMoment($text: String) { createMoment(text: $text) { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } }

name: UpdateMoment
document: mutation UpdateMoment($id: ID!, $text: String) { updateMoment(id: $id, text: $text) { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } }

name: LikeMoment
document: mutation LikeMoment($momentId: ID!) { likeMoment(momentId: $momentId) { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } }

name: ShareMoment
document: mutation ShareMoment($momentId: ID!) { shareMoment(momentId: $momentId) { moment { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } successMessage copies } }

name: MomentEvents
document: subscription MomentEvents { momentEvents { id uuid text likedByMe media createdAt } }

name: RecordEvents
document: subscription RecordEvents { recordEvents { entries { topic action recordId chat { id title revision lists } message { id text chatId } } } }

name: ContainerMembers
document: query ContainerMembers($containerId: String!, $first: Int, $after: String) { node(id: $containerId) { ... on Container { membersCount members(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } }
